verdict.rationale: Appwrite documents its own deletion capabilities: Storage APIs to delete files, CLI and MCP management of rows, files and users, and bucket-level stripping of location, device and capture-time metadata from uploaded images. Self-hosting gives control over data location, but nothing in the evidence describes configurable retention periods, automatic expiry, or account and data purge workflows. missing for 10: configurable retention policies/TTLs, documented end-to-end user-data deletion (account erasure, backup purge), log/telemetry retention controls, independent corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: It provides APIs to upload, download, delete, and list files, with many added utilities.
Storage buckets can now remove location, device, and capture time metadata from uploaded images.
